verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly mention listening to webhooks and external events as durable coordination primitives (restate-docs-6, restate-docs-20), and Restate can receive HTTP invocations that could be triggered by webhook calls (restate-docs-8). However there's no concrete first-class 'webhook subscription' feature, endpoint registration, or signature-verification mechanism documented, and no independent/hands-on confirmation. missing for 10: dedicated webhook subscription/endpoint API, signature verification specifics, hands-on or community confirmation of webhook usage.
